title: THE STASH IS A 90 PERCENT CARD
why: His Q43: windows (Settings, stash and the rest) are a centred card with an X in the corner taking nearly the whole screen. The stash was the one window still edge to edge. Now a card with a 5 percent margin all round, 4 px corners, a scrim around it, the X and credits inside its top right.
now: The stash is a centred 90 percent card like the shop.
